insurer: Zurich Kotak General Insurance Company (India) Limited

room_rent.note: Associated medical expenses proportionally reduced if room exceeds limit

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: 20% co-pay on all admissible claims; waived for Cataract, Dialysis & Home Care Treatment

sub_limits.display: Cataract ₹25k/eye, Dialysis ₹1k/sitting (5/mo), PED claims 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹25,000 per eye per year; Dialysis: ₹1,000/sitting up to 5 sessions/month; PED claims capped at 50% of SI; Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI

deductible.note: Deductible applies on aggregate basis for all hospitalisation in a policy year; exact amount in schedule (illustrations show ₹1,00,000)

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable after 12 months continuous coverage

ped_waiting.note: Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability; PED claims after waiting period capped at 50% of SI

specific_disease_waiting.note: 18 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, dialysis, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's etc.; longer of PED or specific waiting applies

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

post_hosp.note: Capped at 10% of hospitalisation expenses; reimbursement basis only

day_care.note: Medically necessary day-care treatments covered up to SI

domiciliary.note: Listed conditions only; prior approval required; reimbursement basis; 13 listed conditions

ayush.note: Inpatient and day-care AYUSH treatment covered up to Sum Insured

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; linked to admissible hospitalisation claim

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables in Annexure II; pharmacy and consumables excluded from associated medical expenses

global_cover.note: Claims payable only for treatment in India; overseas treatment explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud

grace_period.note: Coverage not available during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not renewals or portability

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; apply 30-60 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Overseas treatment, organ donor hospitalisation, maternity, infertility, domiciliary OPD, dental (non-accidental), STDs, experimental treatment, consumables

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy wording
